title: Permission Values
key_points: The XRPL protocol supports permission levels from 0 to 255.
Permissions allow for granular control over account permissions and trustlines.
Different permission values are used for different actions, such as managing account settings or signing transactions.
limitations: This documentation assumes familiarity with the XRPL protocol and its concepts.
The scope of permission values is limited to the XRPL context and may not apply universally outside this ecosystem.
asserts: Permissions in the XRPL protocol allow for fine-grained control over account permissions and trustlines, with values ranging from 0 to 255.
scope: Describes permission levels in the context of the XRPL (XRP Ledger) protocol
